item.cobblemon_economy_plus.shopkeeper_s: Spawns a shopkeeper linked to the general shop.
Shop / Theme mode: right-click an NPC to give it the next shop or theme.
Right-click in the air: switch Shop / Theme / Admin mode.
Admin mode: right-click an NPC to edit its shop; Shift + right-click in the air to open the admin screen.

Ids use lowercase letters, digits, _ and -, up to 32 characters.

Item %s: the quantity must be 1 to 64.
Item %s: the price must be a whole number of 0 or more.
Item %s: the limit must be a whole number of at least 1 (blank = none).
